title: 2026-10-10 confirmed defect repair ledger
scope: Record confirmed bugs, research each repair, implement bounded regression tests and fixes, review, and create local-only commits.
evidence_boundary: Source findings at baseline; prior passing suites do not prove these repairs. Record new regression results separately. No live security probing or deployment recovery exercise is authorized.

bugs.title: Credential-changing operations do not revoke pending login links and password-reset challenges
bugs.impact: An outstanding credential issued before a password, identity or privilege change can remain usable afterwards.

bugs.title: Automatic snapshot rollback can discard acknowledged post-snapshot writes
bugs.impact: Restoring an online point-in-time snapshot makes later acknowledged writes absent from the active database; retaining the old file does not prevent this logical data loss.

bugs.title: Main can return before HTTP graceful shutdown finishes
bugs.impact: Ordinary in-flight HTTP handlers are not included in the custom shutdown waiter and can be interrupted when main returns or closes dependencies.

bugs.title: Password verification and hashing paths do not share the existing concurrency bound
bugs.impact: Login and password-change work bypasses the password-work gate already used by registration and reset.

bugs.title: Ordinary client limits group users behind a trusted proxy by the proxy address
bugs.impact: Unrelated users share request quotas even when a trusted proxy provides an authenticated forwarding chain.

bugs.title: An abandoned final mail attempt remains pending forever
bugs.impact: Ticket and reminder mail rows at attempt three cannot be reclaimed or finalized after a worker stops or loses its result update.

issues.note: Historical mapping only; do not reopen or claim this issue is newly closed by the repair.

bugs.title: Combined lifecycle rollback rejects an unhealthy current application
bugs.impact: Rollback refuses a correctly identified application precisely when its health has failed.

bugs.title: Appending after an incomplete journal tail corrupts the next durable record
bugs.impact: Load ignores a partial final line but the next append concatenates onto it, so subsequent recovery cannot parse the journal.

bugs.title: Plan mutations invalidate a different cache from the prefetch cache consumed on remount
bugs.impact: Navigating back soon after a successful change can restore stale plan data and revision.

bugs.title: Order detail responses can overwrite a newer selection or reopen a closed detail
bugs.impact: Out-of-order detail responses control the selected order without request sequencing or close invalidation.

bugs.title: Escape in ticket close confirmation dismisses the parent and loses the reply draft
bugs.impact: The parent modal handles Escape while its nested confirmation is active, causing the ticket detail and unsent local draft to unmount.
